configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: What you want 99% of the time: assertions on, fast builds, full warnings.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimised build. Use it when an exercise asks you to reason about what the optimiser does.

configurePresets.name: solutions
configurePresets.description: Also builds and tests the reference solutions under solutions/.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Catches use-after-free, buffer overruns and undefined behaviour at runtime.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Catches data races. Use it for chapter 10 (concurrency).

configurePresets.name: cuda
configurePresets.description: The whole course including chapters 14-17. Use it on the GPU machine. GCC is the host compiler because that is what nvcc is tested against.

configurePresets.name: cuda-release
configurePresets.description: As `cuda`, with -O2 host code. Device code is optimised in every configuration (nvcc does not tie it to CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE), so the timings in chapter 17 are the same either way; this only makes the CPU reference implementations in the tests faster.

configurePresets.name: cuda-solutions
configurePresets.description: As `cuda`, and also builds and tests the reference solutions.
